testCases.input: How does the proposed course integrate blockchain technology with Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, Cybersecurity, and Data Privacy, and why is this interdisciplinary approach important?
testCases.actualOutput: The course integrates blockchain with AI through model provenance and verifiable model tracking, with IoT by securing sensor data and communication, with cybersecurity through identity management and threat detection, and with data privacy by ensuring integrity and decentralized storage. This interdisciplinary approach prepares students to solve real-world problems that require knowledge across multiple computing domains.
